name: Förderung von Uferrückbauten an Oö. Seen
summary: Funding for planning, construction and ecological site supervision when hard shoreline structures on Upper Austrian lakes are removed to restore natural banks, mainly in protected areas. Funding covers up to 30, 50 or 70 percent by improvement.
